jobs.title: Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Build the Client Experience From the Ground Up**



Service Point Pro is a growing company building a modern platform designed to help service businesses operate more effectively. As we bring our platform to market and onboard our first customers, we're looking for an experienced **Onboarding \& Training Specialist** to help define what an exceptional client experience looks like.



This is not simply a training or customer support position. You'll own the client onboarding journey, develop scalable training resources and processes, and become a trusted subject\-matter expert on the Service Point Pro platform.


**What You'll Do**


* Own client onboarding from kickoff and account setup through a successful, on\-time go\-live and confident platform adoption.


* Coordinate client data preparation, imports, account configuration, and launch readiness.


* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding questions, issues, and escalations.


* Track onboarding milestones, blockers, and client status to ensure successful implementation.


* Lead live and recorded software training for new and existing clients.


* Develop and maintain training resources, guides, walkthroughs, FAQs, and supporting documentation.


* Build and continuously improve scalable onboarding playbooks, procedures, and workflows.


* Conduct post\-launch success reviews to evaluate adoption, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.


* Identify client trends, adoption challenges, and feature requests and translate those insights into recommendations for Product and Member Success.


* Serve as a subject\-matter expert on the Service Point Pro platform and client onboarding experience.


**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in client onboarding, customer success, implementation, training, enablement, or a related field.


* Experience independently managing client relationships or onboarding programs from start to finish.


* Demonstrated experience building onboarding processes, training programs, playbooks, or documentation.


* Excellent communication, presentation, and training abilities.


* Ability to make technical concepts understandable for users with varying levels of technical experience.


* Strong organization, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills.


* Self\-directed and comfortable working with autonomy in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


* Strong customer focus and commitment to delivering exceptional client experience.


**Preferred Experience**



Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, Jira, Confluence, Slack, spreadsheets, CSV imports, data onboarding, or similar technology environments is preferred. Experience helping build an onboarding or customer success function in an early\-stage company is a plus.


**Why Service Point Pro?**



This is an opportunity to join Service Point Pro at an important stage of growth. Rather than inheriting a mature onboarding function, you'll help build the processes, training resources, and client experience that the company will scale on.



You'll work closely with department leadership and cross\-functional partners while having meaningful ownership over how customers experience and adopt the platform.



Compensation: $65,000–$85,000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, and geographic market.

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology\-led service with a human touch.### **About the Role**



The Senior Training Specialist owns the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of enablement programs for Customer Success, with a primary focus on onboarding and ongoing skills development for Marketing Assistants and Account Managers. This role independently develops and facilitates training across the Scorpion technology suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal), client communication and service standards, account management practices, and core digital marketing concepts.



Serving as a subject\-matter resource and strategic partner to Customer Success leaders and cross\-functional teams, the Senior Training Specialist identifies learning needs, translates business and performance gaps into effective learning solutions, and uses data and feedback to continuously improve programs. This role helps ensure client\-facing teams build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to ramp quickly and perform consistently.


**Internal candidates will receive priority consideration for this role. However, external applications are welcomed and will be reviewed if the position is not filled internally.**

**About FacilityOS**
====================


FacilityOS is a fast\-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.


As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in\-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.


If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high\-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.


This is a hybrid position in our office in Annapolis, Maryland, where you'll be required to be in the office at least three days a week with the flexibility to work from home the remaining days if desired.

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

### **Customer Implementation \& Rollout**

* Lead end\-to\-end customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live and hypercare.
* Define implementation plans, timelines, milestones, and success criteria; keep projects on track and customers informed.
* Configure FacilityOS solutions to match customer workflows, security requirements, and site\-specific needs.
* Drive rollout readiness across stakeholders (IT, Security, Facilities, Reception/Front Desk, Compliance), ensuring adoption and operational continuity.)

### **Technical Configuration \& Troubleshooting**

* Serve as a technical expert for FacilityOS software, hardware (iPads, printers, mobile computing devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, and other peripheral devices), mobile apps, and integrations.
* Support customer technical discovery (network/Wi\-Fi, device provisioning, permissions, integrations) and identify risks early.
* Diagnose complex issues during implementation, reproduce bugs, document findings, and coordinate resolution.
* Assist with data onboarding (imports/migration), validation, and mapping; ensure data quality prior to launch.
* Use SQL and database concepts to validate records, troubleshoot data issues, and confirm integration outcomes.

### **Training, Enablement \& Documentation**

* Deliver customer training (live sessions, recorded content, and tailored enablement) for admins and end users.
* Create and maintain internal and customer\-facing documentation: implementation guides, configuration playbooks, rollout checklists, and FAQs.

### **Cross\-Functional Execution**
* Act as the coordination point between Professional Services, Support, Engineering, and QA during implementations.
* Provide structured handoff documentation to Support/CS after go\-live (configuration summary, known risks, escalation paths, environment notes).
* Identify recurring implementation friction and propose process improvements to increase speed, quality, and scalability.

**Experience \& Technical Skills**
----------------------------------

* 2\+ years in customer\-facing digital roles (Implementation, Technical Support, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting), ideally supporting enterprise clients and hardware/software products.
* Proven ability to manage multiple customer projects simultaneously, including timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, and networking (Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, firewall/proxy constraints, basic MDM familiarity a plus).
* Experience with tools like Zendesk, Gainsight, Salesforce, Notion, Scribe and Microsoft Suite; comfortable working in ticketing \+ project\-tracking environments
* Knowledge of databases and how they integrate with other platforms; experience or knowledge of basic/intermediate SQL queries (e.g., joins, filtering, validating imports).
* Ability to perform PC software/hardware installations and device setup, including loading applications and hardware drivers.
* Interest in AI for support/enablement or process automation is a plus.

**Implementation / Project Management Skills (Additions)**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Comfortable running implementation calls: kickoff, technical discovery, configuration workshops, training, and go\-live readiness.
* Ability to define scope, manage change requests, and set/maintain expectations to avoid implementation drift.
* Strong documentation habits: requirements capture, decision logs, risks/issues tracking, and clear next steps after every customer touchpoint.
* Experience working with customer IT/security stakeholders and translating requirements into technical configuration steps.

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* Strong problem\-solving and creative thinking.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and ability to drive work to closure.
* Confident communicator who can translate technical topics for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborative, team\-oriented mindset with a customer\-first approach.
* Patient and empathetic approach—especially during high\-stakes go\-lives and escalations.

**Why work at FacilityOS?**


We work hard and play hard and we do both with passion and respect for one another. Our company promotes a fast\-paced, fun, friendly, and highly collaborative work environment that provides:


Comprehensive health coverage


A Hybrid work environment


Opportunity for advancement and growth


Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!


Birthday and Life Celebrations


Two annual parties in a year
